A '''ghostwave''' was a form of encryption developed by the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]]. Each transmission of [[Shadowcast]] was encrypted by hand, then dispatched over a untraceable beam of energy, called a ghostwave. The ghostwave attached itself to a random advertisement transmissions, allowing it to be broadcast over the [[HoloNet/Legends|HoloNet]].
